discrepancies.title: Remote Cloud CUDA Cluster Unprovisioned in Test Sandbox
discrepancies.description: No active remote cloud GPU credentials configured in the development environment; local staging runs on Apple Silicon M2 MPS.
discrepancies.evidence: staging_worker.py reports cloud_cuda_status: BLOCKED. Tested 500 requests on local MPS.

discrepancies.title: MPS Cache Purge Required During High-Throughput Bursts
discrepancies.description: PyTorch MPS does not aggressively release unified memory without explicit torch.mps.empty_cache() calls.
discrepancies.evidence: Added gc.collect() and torch.mps.empty_cache() hook after every job in staging_worker.py.

certification: Zero unaddressed high or critical security discrepancies. Staging worker hardened and audited for production trial.
